goal: DEPTH: sub-sections / config sections in real integration with the backend — raise real coverage and capability levels
must_build: Every page in ui-spec/azure/acr.json (32 pages; nav: Overview, Activity log, Access control (IAM), Tags, Quick start, Events, Settings, Services, Repository permissions, Policies, Monitoring, Automation, Help)
Backend: ARM Microsoft.ContainerRegistry registries + repositories/tags if the registry data plane is modeled
List / create / detail / edit / delete round-trips through the native API the SDK and CLI use
always: Every page wired to the native API on /_wire (no static data); liveness fixtures for every list/detail page
core/capabilities/azure/acr.json: one entry per console section with an honest level + tests; tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py must pass
Capability feature ids MUST start with 'azure.' (e.g. 'azure.acr.<section>') — ids share one namespace with the AWS registry
Read the 'Cloud lenses' section of consoles/AGENT-UI.md first — use this cloud's kit, not Cloudscape

depth_targets.title: "Manage view", "Open query" (Azure Resource Graph) and "Assign tags" on the registries list
limitations: Azure Resource Graph, saved views and bulk tag assignment across resources are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Admin user credentials (listCredentials / regenerateCredential)
limitations: The admin username/passwords are generated and rotated for real and persist on the registry, but Vyomi's repository data plane never checks them (or any other credential) — a docker/oras client can push and pull without presenting them.

depth_targets.title: Activity log
limitations: A simplified, generic ARM activity feed (create/update/delete on this resource), not the real Microsoft.Insights audit trail (callers, correlation ids, full operation metadata); severity/timespan filtering and the secondary toolbar (Edit columns, Export, Insights, Feedback) are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Repositories and tags, over the OCI/Docker Registry v2 wire and the ACR REST repository-metadata extension
limitations: Image layers are never modelled — a manifest PUT is accepted directly without the blob-upload steps a real `docker push` performs first, and manifest bodies are stored and returned verbatim but never validated against a real OCI schema. Repositories are process-global (not scoped to one registry's login server), the same simplification Key Vault's keys/secrets data planes make.

depth_targets.title: Webhooks (Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/webhooks)
limitations: Webhook definitions round-trip through ARM for real (create/list/delete, scoped to this registry), but Vyomi never fires them — a push/delete/quarantine event on this registry never POSTs to the configured Service URI, and there is no Ping action.

depth_targets.title: Access control (IAM) on a registry
limitations: Role assignments, the built-in/custom role catalog, deny assignments and classic administrators scoped to an individual resource are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Overview Monitoring, Capabilities and Recommendations tabs
limitations: Pull/push throughput charts, the capabilities summary and Advisor recommendations are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Insights, Alerts, Metrics, Diagnostic settings and Logs
limitations: Metrics charts, alert rules, diagnostic-setting log routing, Log Analytics queries and the registry insights workbook are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Export template — Bicep and Terraform formats
limitations: The ARM Template tab is generated from the live resource; Bicep and Terraform generation are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Domain name label scope and Role assignment permissions mode (create wizard)
limitations: These 2025 ARM additions are collected in the wizard for fidelity but stored on neither ARM nor the registry record — Vyomi has no DNS label or ABAC-repository-permission layer to apply them to.

depth_targets.title: Quick start, Events, Encryption, Identity, Networking, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Geo-replications, Tasks, Cache, Connected registries, Tokens, Scope maps, Retention (Preview), and Support + Troubleshooting
limitations: These portal blade menu items (push/pull quick-start snippets, CMK encryption, managed identity, private networking, Defender for Cloud, geo-replication, ACR Tasks, cache rules, connected registries, repository-scoped tokens/scope maps, retention policy, and the support tools) are not modeled.

note:
DEPTH PASS (the base console is merged). Goal: turn this service's sub-sections and config sections into REAL backend integrations. For EACH capability entry listed in `depth_targets` decide:
  BUILD — Vyomi can model it in the shared core (state + native API semantics): implement it in core/<svc>_core.py (and the offline route if offline lacks it), add conformance checks in tests/conformance/, raise the entry's level in core/capabilities/<cloud>/<svc>.json (not_simulated→limited/full, config_only→limited/full where now ENFORCED, limited→full where a limitation is removed), wire the console section to it with a UI↔native-API round trip in consoles/tests/smoke-<cloud>.mjs and a "live" fixture for any list/detail page.
  KEEP HONEST — only if it needs something a local simulator cannot run (a separate product, real hardware/network, billing, third-party identity): leave it NotSimulated and put the concrete reason in the entry's `limitations`.
Prefer behaviour that is ENFORCED (e.g. lifecycle rules actually expire objects, a DLQ really receives, a policy really denies) over config that is only stored. Real coverage must go UP; nothing may regress: fidelity ≥ 90%, every capability claim true on nano AND offline, smokes green. Do not edit consoles/honest-allowlist.json or .github/.
House rules: keep consoles/src/<cloud>/kit/Capability.jsx as on base (add JSON imports only), list the service ONCE in registry.js, register any NEW core in wasm/build_cores.py + wasm/nano-boot.js (own line, never inside a // comment) + core/nano_registry.py + core/nano_persist.py (tests/conformance/test_nano_core_manifest.py), unique variable names in the smoke files, 'Vyomi' as plain text, re-vendor with python3 wasm/build_cores.py, rebuild bundles, COMMIT your source.
